title: Page 7
content_zh:
他们究竟在谈些什么？

忍不住地，她再一次在心中自问，却也再一次觉得自己十分没用。

明明说了要放弃、明明说了要死心，可她却只是因为这样，一颗心便揪疼得不得了，而且什么也不能做，只能待在房中自我嫌恶。

懊恼的止住脚步，她闭上双眼，低喊，「绦岚秋，别再想了！」

「别再想什么？」

突如其来的询问让她吓了一跳，连忙睁开双眸，发现进房的正是心心念念的封竞天，一颗心倏地狂跳。

「你、你怎能进我房间？」她其实是想问他和妹妹在外头聊了什么，但却问不出口。

关上房门，他信步朝她走去，一路上没停，逼得她连连后退，直到双腿碰上床沿，险些跌摔，他才一把揽住她的腰，护着她坐了下来，嘶哑的说：「我们是夫妻，当然要睡在一起。」

睡、睡在一起？

绦岚秋双颊倏红，结巴的说：「我、我们明明就已经不是夫妻了……」

闻言，封竞天的眼底闪过一抹愧疚及悔恨。「我知道，但紫嫣他们并不晓得，若你现在把我赶出房，我敢保证她定会冲进来质问你。」

她顿时语塞，羞赧的问：「所以、所以你今晚……真要睡在这？」

「当然！」他点头，满足的嗅着她沐浴后的清香，「先申明，我可没打算打地铺。」

他岂会放过这名正言顺拥她入眠的大好机会。

但绦岚秋却误会他的意思，通情达理的点头。「这是你的房，床当然是由你睡，我去长榻上睡，绝不会打扰到……」

她话还未说完，身子已让他紧紧拥入怀中，那力道大得像是要将她揉入骨血，下一瞬，她粉嫩的小嘴便被他倾身吮住。

唇舌交缠，他的吻仿佛要抽光她所有呼息，那样的狂野、火热，且久久不放，直到她真的受不住，抡起粉拳轻捶他的胸膛，他才不甘愿地将她放开，窝在她的颈间，嘶哑地说：「岚秋，对不起。」

喘息不已的绦岚秋好一会儿才有法子顺过气，用着同样沙哑的嗓音道：「我说过我不会放在心上。」

她以为封竞天还在为伤害她一事而内疚着。

「不……」他摇头，捧起她的螓首，深情的凝望着她，「我不是为那件事道歉。」

他的凝望令她心口一跳，不由自主地反问：「那么……你为何道歉？」

是想告诉她，他爱的人依旧是紫嫣，所以他之前所说的弥补、说要让她感到幸福之事，他无法做到，是吗？

美眸倏地一黯，虽然她从未想过他会爱她，但他这阵子的行为举止，却很容易让人误解。

他的拥抱、他的温柔、他的体贴，还有他的亲吻，不论是哪一样都让她沉迷沦陷，明知这一切不过是因为他的愧疚，她仍忍不住动心动念，产生奢望……

如今，梦醒了，也不过是再次感到心碎罢了，这样也好，他若能早点斩断她的想望也好，真的……很好。

眼眶微红，她虽然极力想忍住眼中的泪水，却还是做不到，一颗颗透明的泪珠就这样滑落双颊。

见她突然落泪，封竞天一颗心倏地一缩，紧张的将她抱得更紧，不停的说：「别哭，别哭了，是我不对，一切都是我不好，是我太过迟钝，才会看不清自己的感情，拜托你别哭了……」

他的安慰毫无用处，她的泪水只是愈落愈凶，甚至浸湿了他的衣襟。

他简直要疯了，她每掉一滴泪，他的心就像是被针扎了无数下，心乱如麻，却不知该如何止住那断了线的珍珠泪滴。

最后，他只能再次吻住她的唇，吻去那一颗颗令他心痛的泪水，嘶声说：「岚秋，我知道我不配爱你，但我希望你能再给我一次机会，我绝对不会再让你流泪、

不会再让你伤心，求你别哭了……」

原是哭得不能自己的绦岚秋闻言果真止住哭泣，抬起带泪的美眸，惊愕的看着他。「你、你刚刚说什么？」

是她听错吗？还是这其实只是一场梦？他怎么可能……

封竞天总算松了口气，将她紧拥入怀，嘶声说：「我爱你。」

这三个字重重撞进绦岚秋的胸口，让那颗原已破碎、伤痛不已的心，再次怦然狂跳。

这是真的吗？她真的没听错？他说……他爱她？

深深凝视着她不可置信的双眸，他柔声又说：「我很抱歉，因为我的愚蠢，让你白白伤心这么多年，让你错过这么多能与我厮守的时间……」

他哑声将今晚与绦紫嫣的对话告诉她，向她忏悔他的迟钝、他的愚蠢，绕了这么一大圈，才知他爱的人一直是她。

听完他的表白，绦岚秋怔然的双眸再次滑下泪，且比上一回落得还要快、还要凶。

「怎么又哭了？」封竞天手忙脚乱地抹着她不断滑下的泪水，温柔却霸道的说：「别哭了，我知道是我不好，让你吃了这么多苦，你怨我、气我，我都能接受，就算是要打我、骂我也行，但休想不要我，这辈子我缠定你了，知道吗？」

闻言，她虽感到一阵甜蜜，泪水却还是不断落下，怎么也止不住。

她不应一声，只是不停的哭，哭得他没辙，只好故计重施，一一吻去她的泪，低声说：「你不答应也不行，我老实告诉你，紫嫣已经知道所有的事，而且我也答应她，我会好好的疼爱你，绝对不会再让你伤心难过。」

听见妹妹居然知道她被休一事，绦岚秋总算止住泪，瞪大美眸看着他，「紫嫣……知道？」

封竞天点头，「她知道，而且她还威胁我，这一回要是我敢再辜负你，她就算是追到天涯海角也要把我大卸八块，扔进海里喂鱼，为了保住我这条小命，你可愿意答应再次成为我封竞天的妻，生生世世、永不分离？」

他眼中的深情是那么深刻、那样真诚，她连作梦都不敢奢望会出现的画面，如今却活生生在她眼前上演，她盼了这么久、等得这么苦，她怎么可能会拒绝？

含着喜极而泣的泪水，她紧紧回抱着他，哽声说：「我愿意，我愿意成为你的妻，与你白头偕老，度过余生……」

得到她的允诺，封竞天欣喜若狂，一颗高悬的心总算落下，再也忍不住满腔的欲望，深深吻住她。「岚秋……我爱你。」

绦岚秋整个人沉浸于感动之中，她终于可以毫无顾忌的拥抱他、回应他，不必猜疑他在抱着自己的同时，脑中想着的是什么人，这让她心头一热，羞涩的回吻着他。

激情过后，绦岚秋喘息着，只能软软的偎在他身上，累得再也动不了。

一夜贪欢，加上稍早的缠绵，封竞天总算感到满足，把玩着她乌黑的发丝，低声问：「累吗？」

她红着脸蛋，轻点头。

他食髓知味，要了她一次又一次，每每她求饶，他便又哄又骗，硬是逗得她与他一同沦陷在欲海之中，一夜下来，她不只是累，根本是累瘫了，双腿酸麻得几乎下不了床。

封竞天心疼的轻吻她的额，「是我太过放纵，下次我定会节制。」

虽是这么说，但他却清楚很难克制对她的欲望，若不是顾及她的身子，他其实还想再要她一次。

「嗯。」她羞怯的点头。

那娇羞的模样让封竞天双眸一黯，感到身下的欲望再次蠢蠢欲动，只好赶紧转移注意力。

「我打算这几日带你回绦家一趟，将这阵子我们之间发生的事告诉岳父。」
content_en:
What on earth were they talking about?

Unable to help herself, she asked herself again, but once again she felt very useless.

She clearly said she wanted to give up, she clearly said she wanted to give up, but just because of this, her heart ached so much that she couldn't do anything but stay in the room and hate herself.

She stopped in annoyance, closed her eyes, and shouted, "Qi Lanqiu, don't think about it anymore!"

"Stop thinking about what?"

The sudden question startled her, and she quickly opened her eyes and found that it was Feng Jingtian who had entered the room whom she had longed for, and her heart was beating wildly.

"How could you enter my room?" She actually wanted to ask him what he and his sister were talking about outside, but she couldn't.

After closing the door, he sauntered towards her, not stopping along the way, forcing her to step back until her legs hit the edge of the bed and almost fell. Then he grabbed her waist, protected her and sat down, saying hoarsely: "We are husband and wife, of course we have to sleep together."

Sleep, sleep together?

Gui Lanqiu's cheeks turned red and she stuttered, "I, we are obviously no longer husband and wife..."

Hearing this, a flash of guilt and regret flashed in Feng Jingtian's eyes."I know, but Zi Yan and the others don't know. If you kick me out of the room now, I'm sure she will rush in and question you."

She was immediately speechless and asked shyly: "So, so you...really want to sleep here tonight?"

"Of course!" He nodded, sniffing her fragrance after bathing with satisfaction, "First of all, I have no intention of laying the floor."

How could he miss this great opportunity to hug her to sleep.

But Qi Lanqiu misunderstood what he meant and nodded reasonable."This is your room. Of course you sleep on the bed. I will sleep on the couch and I will never disturb you..."

Before she could finish her words, her body was hugged tightly by him. The force was so strong that it seemed like he was going to rub her into her bones and blood. The next moment, he leaned forward to suck her pink little mouth.

Their lips and tongues were intertwined, and his kiss seemed to suck out all her breath. It was so wild, hot, and lingering for a long time, until she really couldn't bear it anymore and lightly beat his chest with her pink fist. Then he reluctantly let her go, nestled in her neck, and said hoarsely: "Lan Qiu, I'm sorry."

It took a while for Qi Lanqiu, who was panting heavily, to catch his breath, and said in the same hoarse voice: "I said I won't take it to heart."

She thought Feng Jingtian was still feeling guilty for hurting her.

"No..." He shook his head, held up her head, and stared at her affectionately, "I'm not apologizing for that."

His gaze made her heart skip a beat, and she couldn't help but ask, "Then... why are you apologizing?"

He wants to tell her that the person he loves is still Zi Yan, so he can't do what he said before to make up for it and make her happy, right?

Her beautiful eyes dimmed suddenly. Although she had never thought that he would love her, his behavior these days was easily misunderstood.

His hug, his tenderness, his thoughtfulness, and his kiss, no matter what, made her addicted. Knowing that all this was just because of his guilt, she still couldn't help but have thoughts and extravagant hopes...

Now, when she wakes up from the dream, she just feels heartbroken again. It doesn't matter if this is the case, or if he can cut off her desire earlier, it would be really... good.

Her eyes were slightly red. Although she tried hard to hold back the tears in her eyes, she still couldn't. Transparent tears fell down her cheeks one by one.

Seeing her burst into tears, Feng Jingtian's heart suddenly shrank. He hugged her tighter nervously and kept saying, "Don't cry, don't cry. It's my fault. Everything is my fault. It's because I'm too slow that I can't see my own feelings clearly. Please don't cry..."

His comfort was useless, her tears only became more and more fierce, even soaking his clothes.

He was going crazy. Every time she shed a tear, his heart felt like being pricked by needles countless times. He was so confused that he didn't know how to stop the broken pearl tears.

In the end, he could only kiss her lips again, kissing away the tears that made him heartache, and said in a hissing voice: "Lan Qiu, I know I don't deserve to love you, but I hope you can give me another chance. I will never make you cry again."

I won’t make you sad anymore, please stop crying..."

Guan Lanqiu, who was crying so hard that she couldn't help herself, really stopped crying when she heard this, raised her beautiful tearful eyes, and looked at him in shock."W-what did you just say?"

Did she hear it wrong?Or is this actually just a dream?How could he...

Feng Jingtian finally breathed a sigh of relief, hugged her tightly and hissed, "I love you."

These three words slammed into Guan Lanqiu's chest, causing the broken and painful heart to beat wildly again.

Is this true?Did she really hear that right?He said...he loves her?

Staring deeply into her disbelieving eyes, he said softly: "I'm sorry, because of my stupidity, I have made you sad for so many years and made you miss so much time with me..."

He told her the conversation with Sui Ziyan tonight in a mute voice, confessing to her his slowness and stupidity. After going around in such a big circle, he realized that the person he loved had always been her.

After hearing his confession, tears fell from Guan Lanqiu's eyes again, and they fell faster and more fiercely than last time.

"Why are you crying again?" Feng Jingtian hurriedly wiped away the tears that kept falling from her eyes, and said gently but domineeringly: "Don't cry. I know it's my fault. You've suffered so much. I can accept it if you blame me or make me angry. Even if you want to hit me or scold me, don't think about leaving me. I'm bound to you for the rest of your life, you know?"

Hearing this, although she felt a burst of sweetness, her tears kept falling and she couldn't stop them.

She didn't respond and just kept crying, which made him unable to do anything. He had no choice but to repeat his old trick, kissing away her tears one by one and whispering: "It doesn't matter if you don't agree. I tell you the truth, Zi Yan already knows everything, and I also promised her that I will love you well and will never make you sad again."

Hearing that her sister actually knew about her divorce, Guan Lanqiu finally stopped crying and looked at him with widened beautiful eyes, "Zi Yan...knows?"

Feng Jingtian nodded, "She knows, and she also threatened me. If I dare to let you down this time, she will chase me to the ends of the earth and cut me into pieces and throw me into the sea to feed the fish. In order to save my little life, are you willing to agree to be my wife, Feng Jingtian, again, and never be separated for the rest of our lives?"

The affection in his eyes was so deep and sincere. The scene she never dared to dream about was now happening before her eyes. She had been looking forward to it for so long and waited so hard. How could she refuse?

With tears of joy in her eyes, she hugged him back tightly and choked out: "I do, I want to be your wife, grow old with you and spend the rest of my life..."

After getting her promise, Feng Jingtian was overjoyed. His high heart finally dropped. He could no longer hold back his desire and kissed her deeply."Lan Qiu...I love you."

Qi Lanqiu was immersed in emotion. She could finally hug him and respond to him without any scruples. She didn't have to wonder who he was thinking about while holding her. This made her feel hot and she kissed him back shyly.

After the passion, Guan Lanqiu panted and could only cling to him softly, too tired to move anymore.

After a night of lustful pleasure and the earlier lovemaking, Feng Jingtian finally felt satisfied. He played with her black hair and asked in a low voice, "Are you tired?"

She blushed and nodded lightly.

He knew the taste, and wanted her again and again. Every time she begged for mercy, he would coax and trick her, forcing her to fall into the sea of ​​desire with him. After a night, she was not only tired, she was paralyzed from exhaustion, and her legs were so sore that she could hardly get out of bed.

Feng Jingtian kissed her forehead tenderly, "I was too indulgent. I will control myself next time."

Although he said this, he knew that it was difficult to restrain his desire for her. If it were not for her body, he would actually want her again.

"Yeah." She nodded shyly.

That shy look made Feng Jingtian's eyes darken, and he felt the desire underneath him was about to stir again, so he had to quickly divert his attention.

"I plan to take you back to Sui's house in the next few days and tell my father-in-law what happened between us these days."
